fixes.explanation: You got it, baker. The text says, "So Sennacherib king of Assyria broke camp and withdrew. He returned to Nineveh and stayed there." (2 Kings 19:36) The LORD had said, "He will go back the way he came…" (2 Kings 19:33) Nineveh is where the text says he ends up. He went home, just as the LORD said.
